title: Prove cost 20 on the four remaining physical C5 cores
body:
## Summary

```text
Four residual physical C5 cores after PR3268/3271
  all forced singleton/pair rank blocks
  actual weighted rectangular tariffs and equality traces
  arbitrary finite asymmetric cost >=20
  exact cost20 fits attain
```

Add one self-contained proof/replay package, `research/c5-residual-trace-completion/`, for `(3,10,4,6,13)`, `(3,10,12,23,13)`, `(6,13,23,54,26)` and `(14,24,47,18,55)`. The theorem permits arbitrary finite term counts and coefficients over Q/R/C, ordinary transpose, and the inherited complete-plane tariff. PR3271 already resolves the excluded fifth residual.

Credit thakrarsagar's PR3256 rank/trace method, PR3268 `ee5d4f466e6e44a1897896324a36aa4c64cf3912` residual handoff and PR3271 `1bbe044ba2c7187dba149e40734179b2a1ebba84`, Tekalign/PR2782 geometry, Arham Tahir/PR2879, Sagar Thakrar/PR2484, Cinna Davis/PR1825, Adam Gall/PR1889, Nick Petalas/PR3248, PR3232, ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained E8/P112 lineage. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19003763).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the old fixed cover/trace certificate left these four cores unresolved.
  **After:** 4,096 exact tariff inequalities and 58 cost18/19 cases exclude all targets across 5,327 count states. Every core has an exact cost20 fit. A literal cost19 support multiset passes rank counts and fails traces.
- Registered Python 3.12.15 replay, separate dense binary/integer trace/cost-layer reconstruction and five optimized behavioral groups pass. Fixed path inventories and usages reject source corruption, malformed rows and provenance reclassification. No numerical solver is required.
- Ruff diagnostics/formatting pass. All 13 scientific committed package/input comparisons and export integrity pass. The actual committed read-only Git-free export passes all three scripts under optimized Python 3.15.0. Worker 2 inspected the actual proof, all code, sources and exact receipt, then independently passed the read-only export on optimized isolated Python 3.13.16. No blocking issue was found. REVIEW.json records the scope and unrun obligations. All 14 final package/input byte comparisons and export integrity pass at `67c1360a7a6e81bcac515c698d56656454340b10`.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/c5-residual-trace-completion
```

Baseline canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Both live scientific inputs are canonical-main blobs; fresh CI requires no pending-PR executable or Git object. Open next questions and unrun obligations are explicit. No global 112-port floor, native program, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier update is claimed. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, human review and proof-kernel review were not run. Local checks do not establish hosted CI success.

The [concurrent same-four-core claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19003766) proposes rational separating inequalities. This independently prepared certificate uses complete finite-state count closure. Both are credited; no exclusivity or priority claim is made. Submission overlap at 20:26Z covered 323 open PRs and 2,115 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Closed history, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhausted.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in research package. Frozen predecessors, shared verifiers and selected records are unchanged. Archival retention is not supplier admission.
